ModMetaData.name: IsoRim Waylith - VGE Pack
ModMetaData.author: Peren.
ModMetaData.description:
Vanilla Gravship Expanded in IsoRim's 3D view and on IsoRimZ floors.
3D models for VGE (Chapter 1 and 2): - About 390 models: gravship furniture, consoles, thrusters, shields, oxygen and fuel parts, crates and small props - Ship guns on raised frames that rise through the roof, with shots and lasers leaving the barrel - Enemy gravships and their parts, mech turrets and structures, destroyed variants - VGE mechs, insects and the wormspitter; vacsuits and helmets, dyeable like vanilla gear - VGE armour hull corners stand in 3D and fly with the ship - Enemy gravships fly in as 3D ships, with thruster flames, engine glow and dust
Floors with IsoRimZ (optional): - VGE subarmor and subscaffold can be built on upper decks; VGE artillery damages decks, and they can be repaired - Enemy gravships land on the ground; artillery, salvagers and turrets work across floors - Vac barrier roof colours and fog stay right on upper decks
Needs the latest IsoRim Waylith; older versions load with fewer models.
让 Vanilla Gravship Expanded 在 IsoRim 的 3D 视角和 IsoRimZ 的楼层上正常工作。
VGE 的 3D 模型（第一章和第二章）： - 约 390 个模型：逆重飞船家具、控制台、推进器、护盾、氧气和燃料设施、箱子和小摆件 - 舰炮装在高架上，从屋顶伸出，炮弹和激光从炮口射出 - 敌方逆重飞船和它们的部件、机械族炮塔和建筑、毁坏版本 - VGE 的机械族、虫族和外星蠕虫；真空服和头盔，可以像原版装备一样染色 - VGE 装甲船体的拐角显示为 3D，并随飞船一起起飞 - 敌方飞船以 3D 形式飞来降落，带推进器火焰、引擎光晕和扬尘
IsoRimZ 楼层支持（可选）： - 可以在上层甲板上建造 VGE 下层装甲和下层脚手架；VGE 火炮会打坏甲板，甲板可以修复 - 敌方飞船降落在地面上；火炮、拾荒者和炮塔可以跨楼层正常工作 - 上层甲板的真空屏障屋顶颜色和战争迷雾保持正确
需要最新版 IsoRim Waylith；版本较旧时也能加载，只是模型会少一些。
